convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iCCI, iMA). Simple crossover entry/exit rules with fixed SL/TP. No external .mqh libraries. Standard market execution with position check. Straightforward conversion to Python.
custom_logic_notes: The EA applies a digit adjustment factor: SL and TP pip values are multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001, converting pips to points for 5-digit brokers. The CCI indicator values are smoothed using iMA applied to the CCI handle output (first indicator handle), creating a signal line similar to a smoothed CCI. Signal reversal closes opposite position before entering new one.
python_conversion_notes: Standard crossover strategy on CCI vs its moving average. Use pandas_ta or ta-lib for CCI calculation, then apply SMA over CCI values for the signal line. Entry on crossover of CCI above/below its smoothed line. Must implement the 5-digit point adjustment: if price decimals==5, multiply SL/TP input values by 10 before converting to price offset. New bar detection required - compare current bar time to stored last bar time. Position check before entry - count open positions for the symbol and EA magic number. Signal reversal: close opposite position on crossover before opening new one.
